body:
## What it does

Deliberately not a task bot: it is a sandbox for making things, and it opens clean for each new person rather than carrying the author's projects with it. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @princess414141 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
